term: same necessary root with structural immateriality, intellect and will
definition: Fifteen-input same-witness composition. Import ROOT-WITHOUT-LIMITING-PRINCIPLE with its eleven unchanged inputs and retain ONE actual concrete necessary root n. Extract represented essence/esse identity, noncomposition and firstness from its three-horn exclusion under the retained explicit EM. Composition-kinds excludes matter-form composition of n. The separately retained no-component-first-being reading (ledger L) excludes n entering the composition of ANY other being; this is different from n being noncomposite. Apply the existing altogether-immaterial-to-intellectual and intellect-to-will readings to this SAME n. The endpoint retains its rootness, necessity, represented identity, simplicity, firstness, matter-form exclusion, remoteness, intellect and will. No genus causality, maximality, God naming or new opaque bridge is used. Primitive intellect/will do not certify omniscience, libertarian freedom or explanatory adequacy. All source/applicability and causal/priority correspondence premises remain explicit open commitments; no philosophical premise is discharged. Four additional existing inputs relative to the eleven-input route; no global minimality or weaker-overall-bundle claim.
note: Reuse existing meanings of IsSimple, IsFirstBeing, RemoteFromAll, HasIntellect and HasWill. No new metaphysical relation or source attribution. Original fields remain unchanged in the omission interpretation; false primitive assignments are accompanied by explicit retained q14/q19 interface checks. The q14 interface remains an explicit open bridge from structural immateriality to positive cognitive aptitude; its independent reception/grade gap persists in docs/immaterial-intellect-reception.md and ATTEMPT-Q14-IMMATERIAL-INTELLECT-RECEPTION. This composition does not derive cognitive aptitude from a bare absence of components or interpret the root as passively learning creaturely information.
